title: get_order_info
description: Retrieve order details from the CRM system. Caller must provide a valid CRM user token.

crm_user_token.description: CRM API key issued to the user by the CRM admin
crm_user_token.hint: Obtain from your CRM admin panel under Settings > API Keys

order_id.description: Order ID to retrieve, e.g. ORD-123

include_items.description: Whether to include line items in the response
